clue.text: Accepting teams that are ranging themselves with one party or another

definitions.text: ranging themselves with one party or another

parts.note: accepting something means taking it
teams are the sides in a match

explanation.surface: Picking up teams that are lining up behind one faction or another.
explanation.definitionFit: To back one faction in a dispute is to commit to it rather than stay neutral; the phrase is an idiom for partisanship.

clue.text: Expel number of people attending event

explanation.surface: Throw out the crowd that came to an event.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw someone out is to put them outside; the size of a crowd at a gathering or election is also called this.

clue.text: If ken moves it will cut

indicators.note: moves tells us the letters of the words if ken shift into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A man called Ken who stirs himself will make a cut, conditionally.
explanation.definitionFit: A bladed tool is the thing used for slicing, so it will cut.

clue.text: How one goes about with no clothes on!

definitions.text: How one goes about with no clothes on!

parts.words: How one goes about with no clothes on!
parts.note: the clue asks for the adverb describing the manner of walking around undressed

explanation.surface: A remark about wandering around without clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb describes doing anything while bare, in an unclothed manner.

clue.text: Head cleaner

parts.note: looks like a senior janitor, but read as a product that washes the head, that is the hair

explanation.surface: The chief of the cleaning staff.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair wash is used to clean the scalp and hair on the head.

clue.text: Beau reported celebrity's bloomer

indicators.note: reported signals that a word is heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: a beau is a dandy, a fashionable man
a lion is a celebrity, a social star; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: A gossip column reports that a famous person's boyfriend made a blunder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bloomer' looks like a blunder but means a flower. DANDY spoken sounds like DANDE, then add LION, an old word for a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: A bloomer is anything that flowers, and this yellow weed is a common flowering plant.

clue.text: Central European region lies ruined with eastern half of Russia

indicators.note: ruined means the letters of lies are wrecked and rebuilt in another order
in an across-style reading the east is the right-hand end, so the back half of the word Russia

explanation.surface: A region of central Europe lies in ruins alongside the eastern part of Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruined' turns LIES into SILE; 'eastern half of' takes SIA, the last three letters of RUSSIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Silesia is a historical region now mostly in Poland, with parts in the Czech Republic and Germany.

clue.text: Midlands town taking raw material to Scottish town

indicators.note: material is read as raw stuff to be reworked, signalling the letters of raw are rearranged

parts.note: Wick is a town in the far north of Scotland

explanation.surface: An English town shipping unprocessed goods to a town in Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'material' rearranges RAW into WAR. WICK is a town in Caithness, northern Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Warwick is the county town of Warwickshire in the English Midlands.

clue.text: Undertook domestic hanging

parts.note: suggests a grim household execution, but the hanging is of paper on the walls at home

explanation.surface: Someone carried out an execution at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Decorating a room by pasting rolls of patterned paper on its walls is called hanging it.

clue.text: Lady by lake superior in the united states had ring of cells

parts.note: Ann is a woman's name
U is the abbreviation for upper-class, that is superior
US is the abbreviation for the United States

explanation.surface: A woman beside Lake Superior in America had a circle of cells.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lake Superior' reads as the American lake, but the words split: U, the British label for upper-class (superior), comes before L for lake.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology the term names a ring-shaped structure, such as a band of cells.

clue.text: Shunted?

parts.note: a railway word for moving a train onto another line, hinting at being diverted from the main purpose

explanation.surface: A railway carriage moved aside.
explanation.definitionFit: Being diverted from the main track, literally on a railway or figuratively from a task, is the sense.

clue.text: At liberty not to get tight

explanation.surface: Free, and determined not to get drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Something at liberty is free and unconfined; something slack is the opposite of taut, and to let go of a knot is to slacken it.

clue.text: Gloomy journalists in action

indicators.note: in places the word for journalists inside the word for action

parts.note: a deed is an action
the press is the collective name for journalists

explanation.surface: Reporters at work look downcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling low in spirits is a synonym for gloomy.

clue.text: Dawdle with unknown number of earthenware vessels

parts.note: to potter is to dawdle or idle about
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: Idle around with some quantity of clay pots.
explanation.definitionFit: Fired clay ware such as pots and jugs is the collective term for earthenware vessels.

clue.text: Way that's green first for self-contained community!

indicators.note: first tells us the word for green comes at the front, before the word for way

parts.note: eco is a prefix meaning environmentally friendly, green
a system is a way or method of doing things

explanation.surface: Being environmentally minded comes first for an isolated community.
explanation.definitionFit: A biological community of organisms interacting with their environment as a self-sufficient unit is the ecological term.

clue.text: Chemical found in box I'd anticipated

indicators.note: found in signals the letters run inside the words box I'd anticipated

explanation.surface: A chemical was discovered in a box, as I had expected.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxidising agent is a chemical substance that takes electrons from another.

clue.text: Greek character arranging a loan for musical instrument

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: arranging means the letters of a loan are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A Greek fellow arranges a loan to buy an instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek character' suggests a person from Greece, but it is a letter. 'arranging' turns A LOAN into ANOLA.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-playing piano driven by perforated paper rolls is a mechanical musical instrument.

clue.text: Finished crossing

explanation.surface: Done, and going across.
explanation.definitionFit: When something is ended it is completely done; spreading across every part, a thing covers everywhere.

clue.text: Desert players performing

parts.note: a band is a group of musical players
on means on stage, performing

explanation.surface: Musicians playing in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Desert' looks like a noun, sandy land, but is the verb meaning leave behind.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave someone in the lurch is to forsake or walk out on them.

clue.text: One forgets having this

parts.note: describes a condition whose sufferer cannot remember, so also forgets having it

explanation.surface: A wry remark that a person forgets ever having had something.
explanation.definitionFit: Loss of memory is the medical condition in which a person forgets.

clue.text: Sterility of pies ass produced!

indicators.note: produced signals the letters of pies ass are made into something new

explanation.surface: A donkey bakes pies with questionable hygiene.
explanation.definitionFit: Absence of harmful bacteria, as in surgery, is a synonym for sterility.

clue.text: Runner on line prevented from having pan

parts.note: a ski is a runner that slides over snow
let is an old verb meaning hinder or prevent, surviving in the phrase without let or hindrance

explanation.surface: An athlete on the starting line was stopped from carrying a pan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Runner' suggests an athlete but is a ski. LET in the old sense means prevented, as in tennis's let or the legal phrase 'without let'.
explanation.definitionFit: A frying pan with a long handle is called this, especially in North America.

clue.text: Broadcast event

parts.note: reads as a televised occasion, but the transmitting sense of relaying is used for a team race passing a baton

explanation.surface: An occasion shown on television.
explanation.definitionFit: A team running race where the baton is handed on, as a signal is passed on in transmission.

clue.text: Fast living

explanation.surface: Living fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapid movement is one sense; the old phrase the quick and the dead uses it to mean alive.

clue.text: Friend did not finish shudder

indicators.note: did not finish means the word for friend loses its final letter

parts.note: a Quaker is a member of the Religious Society of Friends

explanation.surface: A pal who failed to complete something shivered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Friend' with a capital is a Quaker, a member of the Religious Society of Friends.
explanation.definitionFit: A trembling or shaking movement is what this word describes, a synonym for shudder.

clue.text: Given up to the faithful

explanation.surface: Handed over to the loyal believers.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dedicated to something means having given oneself up to it; loyal and steadfast followers are also described this way.

clue.text: Played for time when engine stopped

explanation.surface: Delayed tactics when the motor cut out.
explanation.definitionFit: Stonewalling to delay is one sense; an engine that cuts out unexpectedly has also done this.

clue.text: Suggestive of short skirts in not long ago

indicators.note: in places the word for short skirts inside the word for not long ago

parts.note: recent means not long ago
minis are miniskirts

explanation.surface: Short skirts were in fashion not long ago, which brings back memories.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that calls an earlier thing to mind is evocative or suggestive of it.
